title: Can a lever lift a heavy load?
question: Is the same load easier to lift if you push far from the pivot?
steps: Pick one of the three push points on the bar.
Press and hold the red push point on the bar.
Change the push point and compare the force needed on the graph.
observe: The longer the distance from the pivot to the push point, the less force you need. While you hold the push point, see whether the clockwise and counterclockwise torques balance the moment the bar lifts.

terms.name: Lever
terms.description: A bar resting on a pivot that turns a small force into a big one.

terms.name: Pivot
terms.description: The point a lever turns around.

terms.name: Torque
terms.description: How much a force tries to turn an object.

terms.name: Rotational balance
terms.description: When the clockwise and counterclockwise torques add up to 0.

law.title: The lever and rotational balance
law.description: When the bar is balanced, the torques on both sides of the pivot are the same size and in opposite directions.

tip: Pick a push point (near, middle, far) and press and hold the bar's red push point with one finger. The push grows by 110 N each second (the bar beside it fills, up to 400 N; once it starts to move, the push stays there). Let go and the bar comes back down.
tip_short: Press and hold the bar's red push point

controls.label: Push point
controls.note: Choose at what share of the distance from the pivot to the bar's right end you push.

predict.question: If you push near the pivot, will the chest lift easily?

choices.label: It takes a lot of force

predict.reason: Pushing near the pivot, it's hard for the bar to lift the chest. So you must push very hard.
predict.bridge: Press it and see for yourself!

stages.text: Push the bar near the pivot to lift the treasure chest!
stages.say: The place that holds the bar up is called the pivot. Pushing near the pivot, the chest is hard to lift. You must push very hard.
stages.miss: Press Near and hold it longer!

stages.text: Push the bar in the middle to lift the treasure chest!
stages.say: Pushing a bit farther from the pivot takes less force.
stages.win: Up it goes! The piece is coming up!
stages.miss: Press and hold the middle point!

stages.text: Push the bar far out to lift the treasure chest gently!
stages.say: The farther from the pivot you push, the less force it takes. The bar lifts the chest easily. A gentle push is enough.

story.clue: The piece is stuck under the treasure chest! Let's press the bar and lift the chest.
story.map_clue: There's something under the red seesaw!

kid.intro: This is the lever lab. The place that holds the bar up is called the pivot. Push one side of the bar down and the load on the other side goes up. The farther from the pivot you push, the less force it takes. Let's see where it is easiest to push!
kid.title: Lift a heavy load with a bar!
kid.say: The farther from the pivot you push, the less force it takes. So you can lift even a heavy load gently.
kid.tip: Press and hold the bar's red push point.

note.law: The farther from the pivot you push, the smaller the force that lifts the load. It lifts when force × distance (torque) is the same on both sides.
